name: Mengerskirchen (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically blue and yellow, charged above the centre with the arms of Mengerskirchen (a castle with a saint on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Mengerskirchen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Mengerskirchen arms — castle with saint on yellow
